why.title: A pro career comes down to a few key decisions.
why.intro: The numbers of professional football explain the value of structured support, whether you're a young player trying to break through or a club negotiating a signing.

one.label: of young players ever sign a pro contract
one.detail: Out of 21.5 M young players registered worldwide, only ~113,000 play at pro level according to FIFA.

two.label: of represented players are youths, not senior pros
two.detail: CIES Football Observatory: most of an agent's work happens upstream, on emerging talent.

three.label: in agent commissions in 2025
three.detail: Out of $13.08 B in global transfers: the market only validates an agent on results.

one.title: Framed negotiations
one.text: FIFA capped agent fees at 3-5% of annual gross salary since 2023. Structured support goes after the clauses that make the difference in a framework where improvisation is costly.

two.title: A career plan, not a transfer
two.text: Yearly turnover in German academies hits 24.5%, with less than a 50% chance of still being there three years later. Anticipating the next step before you need it changes the trajectory.

three.title: Early identification
three.text: CIES observes that the majority of players under agent care are young talents: an agency's added value is built before the first pro contracts, not after.

four.title: Single point of contact on the club side
four.text: A centralised file (player card, marketing PDF, history) and one dedicated agency contact: the club shortens its decision cycle and reduces its legal exposure.

seo.title: About
seo.description: Rene Football, football agency founded by René Jacob Yougbaré in 2010 in Luxembourg. Representation, scouting, long-term career support.

hero.title: A boutique agency, based in Luxembourg.
hero.paragraph: Rene Football has been supporting players and their families since 2010. We work with a small number of mandates on purpose: that's what lets us be there when it matters, not just at transfer time.

founderQuote.quote: "My goal is to keep young footballers from missing the right opportunities — and to help them advance in their careers with a real plan."
founderQuote.paragraph: Coming from a professional football background, I've seen too many opportunities slip away because of a lack of proper guidance. Today, as an agent, my aim is to bring clarity, serious follow-up and a useful network to the players we represent.

pillars.title: What we do for a player.
pillars.intro: We'd rather do fewer things, and do them well. Here are the three areas we cover for each player under mandate.

representation.title: Representation
representation.text: One agent, one legal counsel and one mental coach per player. We keep the team small so everyone can talk to each other when a decision has to be made.

scouting.title: Scouting
scouting.text: Our scouting network covers the Benelux, France, Germany and the Netherlands. We watch what happens on the pitch first, before the paperwork.

career.title: Long-term support
career.text: Contract, image, schooling, partnerships. We think in ten-year careers, not the next transfer window.

staff.title: A small, hand-picked cell.
staff.intro: Four complementary profiles. No middlemen between you and the person handling your case.

partners.title: Who we work with.
partners.intro: Agency networks, physical preparation, legal counsel. We surround ourselves with partners who share the same commitment to long-term follow-up.

summary.title: In short
bullets: Rene Football is a Luxembourg-based football agency.
All site content (photos, player data, PDFs, articles) belongs to Rene Football. No reuse without written permission.
The site runs over HTTPS; servers are located in the European Union.
Governing law: Luxembourg. Any dispute falls under Luxembourg courts.

summary.title: In short
bullets: We collect only what you submit through the contact form (name, email, phone, message, profile-specific fields, optional CV) plus your IP and user-agent for anti-spam.
No analytics, no advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, no profiling.
Data is accessed only by Rene Football's team and direct technical providers (hosting, email). Never sold or shared for marketing.
Third-party services touching your browser: Google Fonts (IP only), YouTube in privacy mode (no cookie before you click Play), flagcdn.com.
Retention: 12 months for unhandled requests, contract term + 5 years for ongoing relationships.
GDPR rights (access, rectification, deletion, portability, objection): write to contact@renefootball.com with subject RGPD. Reply within one month.
Complaints: CNPD Luxembourg — 15 boulevard du Jazz, L-4370 Belvaux — cnpd.public.lu.

summary.title: In short
bullets: This site drops no tracking, analytics or advertising cookie.
We only use strictly-necessary local storage: theme preference, admin session token (if you're logged in), tutorial dismissals.
No user consent required for these — they're exempt under CNPD guidance — but we document them for full transparency.
Third-party services with browser reach: Google Fonts (IP only, no cookie), YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode (no cookie before you click Play), flagcdn.com for flag icons.
You can clear the local storage anytime from your browser settings. Clearing the admin token logs you out of the back-office.
